body:
Awesome! Thanks for your work! The size is indeed noticeable 👍 

Not sure if you guys are already using the ES6 modules for **loadash** and just importing the methods that you need, but if you don't, you can make even more improvements by using [lodash-webpack-plugin](https://github.com/lodash/lodash-webpack-plugin) and [babel-plugin-lodash](https://github.com/lodash/babel-plugin-lodash) which will transform the importing syntax to be tree-shakable.
